originalTitle: Watch: Is Trump's $5,000 election pledge legal?
summary: The US president has said every American will get $5,000 (£3,700) if the Republican Party wins November's midterms.
content:
Donald Trump has pledged $5,000 (£3,700) to every American if the Republicans win the midterm elections in November.

The US president offered no details on how the plan would work or where the money would come from.

Democrats labelled it an "empty promise" and others have questioned whether such a pledge is even legal

BBC North America editor Sarah Smith looks into whether Trump's promise - which would cost the US government some $1.3 trillion - stands up.
chineseTitle: 观看：特朗普 5000 美元的竞选承诺合法吗？
chineseSummary: 美国总统表示，如果共和党赢得 11 月中期选举，每个美国人将获得 5,000 美元（3,700 英镑）。
chineseContent:
唐纳德·特朗普承诺，如果共和党赢得 11 月中期选举，将向每个美国人提供 5,000 美元（3,700 英镑）。

美国总统没有透露该计划如何运作或资金从何而来的细节。

民主党人称其为“空洞的承诺”，其他人则质疑这样的承诺是否合法

BBC 北美版编辑莎拉·史密斯 (Sarah Smith) 调查了特朗普的承诺——这将使美国政府损失约 1.3 万亿美元——是否兑现。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于全球新闻信号，适合用于观察外部环境、政策变化、地缘风险和市场情绪。
